- Megan's busy periods: 9:00-9:30, 10:00-10:30, 12:00-14:00, 15:00-15:30, 16:00-16:30.

Both are free from 11:00 to 12:00:

- Megan is free from 10:30 to 12:00, so 11:00-12:00 is fully available.
